csv_scope_of_work: Term Contract for Multidisciplinary Professional Architectural and Engineering Services The selected Offeror shall furnish all expertise, labor and resources, in accordance with the requirements of the VT Manual, to provide complete services necessary for Project Order(s) issued during the Contract Term. Prepare an A/E cost estimate for proposed projects; B. Provide evaluations, analysis, recommendations, cost and time estimates, reports, feasibility studies, design documents, field inspections and investigations, and code compliance investigation for architectural, structural engineering, mechanical engineering, or civil engineering projects. Page 6 of 13 C. Develop design submissions consistent with the requirements of the VT CPSM. Respond to all University and other review agency comments and resolve outstanding design issues prior to submission of follow-on design phases; D. Provide complete contract documents for small project designs in accord with the procedures of the VT CPSM for projects assigned by the Project Order; E. Provide services to investigate problems and prepare recommendations for corrective action; F. Prepare feasibility studies for proposed projects; G. Other types of professional services of a nature consistent with the intent of the RFP. A/E firms completing project orders for work, such as feasibility studies, programming, or bridging documents, shall not be precluded from participating in subsequent competitive negotiation procurements for future services arising from such work. All work product produced, such as feasibility studies, programming, or bridging documents, shall be provided to the Owner for inclusion as attachments in any subsequent competitive negotiation procurements related to the project.
